n369f0f7c458.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
n369f0f7c458.x: Anti-Terrorism Day is observed on 21 May, not 11 May; the other three dates are correct.

nc810af49e7e.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nc810af49e7e.x: Civil Services Day is on 21 April. National Voters' Day is 25 January, Constitution Day 26 November and National Youth Day 12 January.

n20ea5879ec3.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: National Students' Day – Atal Bihari Vajpayee
n20ea5879ec3.x: National Library Day (12 August) honours S.R. Ranganathan. Students' Day is linked to A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, Good Governance Day to Vajpayee, and Birsa Munda to Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas.

n11062c667f1.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bhupen Hazarika – 150th birth anniversary on 31 October 2025
Satish Gujral – 150th birth anniversary on 31 October 2025
n11062c667f1.x: Bhupen Hazarika's birth centenary was observed in 2025. Sardar Patel's 150th birth anniversary fell on 31 October 2025, and Satish Gujral's centenary stamp was issued in August 2026.

nc22d0dba4b8.s: Satish Gujral, honoured with a centenary stamp in August 2026, wrote which autobiography?
nc22d0dba4b8.x: Satish Gujral's autobiography is 'A Brush with Life'.

ne1eab6db37e.s:
Arrange the following observances in calendar order (earliest first):
1. Hindi Diwas
2. National Sports Day
3. National Library Day
4. Teachers' Day
ne1eab6db37e.x: Library Day is 12 August, Sports Day 29 August, Teachers' Day 5 September and Hindi Diwas 14 September.

n330d68e492b.s: Who released the Telugu translation of Ram Madhav's book 'Partitioned Freedom and Our Constitution - Our Pride' at the 36th Vijayawada Book Festival?
n330d68e492b.x: M. Venkaiah Naidu released the translation at the festival (January 2026); Kollu Ravindra was its chief guest.

n1f15243955c.s: Bhawaiya, the subject of a book released by the Vice-President, is a folk music tradition of:
n1f15243955c.x: Bhawaiya is folk music of North Bengal and Assam, associated with the Koch Rajbanshi community.

nb5d3e4afff5.s: Which of the following pairs of book and author is correctly matched?
nb5d3e4afff5.x: Maayaamanushyar is by N. Prabhakaran. Crimson Spring is by Navtej Sarna, Jeete Jee Allahabad by Mamta Kalia and Flesh by David Szalay.

n7b080fd680a.s:
Consider the following statements about observances in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Yoga Day, Youth Day and the Day against Drug Abuse are observed in all districts.
2. These observances are limited to Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n7b080fd680a.x: Andhra Pradesh observes all three days in all districts, so they are not limited to two cities.

n6f8b4806a75.s: Who was elected President of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly (2026-27)?
n6f8b4806a75.x: Khalilur Rahman of Bangladesh won the post, defeating Cyprus's candidate.

n73dede46aa4.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. TIME 100 is published by TIME magazine.
2. TIME Person of the Year is published by TIME magazine.
3. The Forbes billionaires list is published by TIME magazine.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n73dede46aa4.x: TIME publishes TIME 100 and Person of the Year; the Forbes billionaires list is published by Forbes, not TIME.

naa55f5ba875.s: Which of the following pairs of State and Chief Minister is correctly matched?
naa55f5ba875.x: C. Joseph Vijay became CM of Tamil Nadu in 2026; Suvendu Adhikari is the West Bengal CM and D.K. Shivakumar the Karnataka CM.

n3f8cd66f431.s: In June 2025, Bobby Mukkamala, with roots in Krishna district of Andhra Pradesh, became the first person of Indian heritage to head the:
n3f8cd66f431.x: Bobby Mukkamala became the first person of Indian heritage to head the American Medical Association in June 2025.
